plan.title: Modules 4-5: xBRIEF Durable State and Source-Projection Boundaries

narratives.Description: Teach xBRIEF 0.8 artifact roles, lifecycle folders, durable state, and source-versus-generated-projection boundaries. The work includes an artifact-classification exercise and a disposable projection-drift recovery lab.
narratives.Acceptance: Module 4 lets a learner classify PROJECT-DEFINITION, specification, scope, plan, and continue artifacts and explain why chat is not authoritative state. Module 5 lets a learner reject a direct generated-file edit, change the authoritative source, render the projection with verified commands, and prove freshness.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: xBRIEF 0.8 project and work state; source-versus-projection boundaries
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Author Module 4 and xBRIEF artifact-classification exercise

narrative.Acceptance: A learner accurately identifies each current xBRIEF artifact and lifecycle folder, distinguishes durable state from chat context, and verifies the classification with explained feedback.

items.title: Author Module 5 and projection-drift recovery lab

narrative.Acceptance: The fictional lab proves safe recovery by editing a declared source, regenerating its projection, checking freshness, resetting deterministically, and never changing the training repository itself.
